content.title: What time does Sam’s Club open & close? The warehouse club’s hours explained
content.text: Key PointsSam's Club opens daily at 9:00 a.m.; Plus members can enter at 8:00 a.m.Sam's Club is closed on New Year's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. It closes early on Christmas Eve.The least crowded times to visit are usually the exclusive Plus member hours, mid-morning on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, or the club's last open hour on weekdays. ContentsSam’s Club’s hours at a glanceWhen does Sam’s Club open? When does Sam’s Club close? When are Sam’s Club’s exclusive shopping hours for Plus members? What holidays does Sam’s Club close for? Sam’s Club is America’s second-favorite warehouse club after Costco, with tens of millions of members nationwide and over 600 stores in the U.S. as of 2026. Due to its immense popularity, the Walmart subsidiary’s retail warehouses can get hectic at times, with crowded parking lots and long checkout lines during peak shopping hours. Luckily for members, Sam’s Club is open a half hour longer than Costco on weekdays, an hour longer on Saturdays, and an hour and a half longer on Sundays. It also has fewer holiday closures. Shoppers hoping to stock up on essentials without getting held up by crowds should keep Sam’s Club’s operating hours in mind and try to plan their visits during less crowded days and times when possible. Here’s everything you need to know about Sam’s Club’s weekday and weekend hours, exclusive shopping hours for Plus members, the least crowded days and times to visit, holiday closure schedule, and more. Plus members get access to an exclusive early shopping hour each day from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., during which they can enjoy smaller crowds and shorter checkout lines. (Plus members also get access to a host of additional benefits in exchange for paying a higher annual membership fee.) When does Sam’s Club close? Sam’s Club closes at 8:00 p.m. every day for all members, except for Christmas Eve, when it closes early at 6:00 p.m. Sam’s Club Plus members can start shopping an hour early every day, from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. At 9:00 a.m., the warehouse club opens to all club members. Plus members can also access curbside pickup and delivery services beginning at 7:00 a.m., a full two hours before these services begin for other club members. You may unsubscribe from email communication at anytime. What holidays does Sam’s Club close for? Sam’s Club closes only four days per year, on the following holidays: New Year’s Day Easter Thanksgiving Christmas As mentioned above, Sam’s Club also closes early at 6:00 p.m. on Christmas Eve. What holidays does Sam’s Club stay open for? Sam’s Club remains open, with typical shopping hours, on the following holidays: Martin Luther King Day President’s Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Halloween New Year’s Eve What are the least-crowded days and times to visit Sam’s Club? For Plus members, Sam’s Club’s exclusive shopping hours from 8:00 to 9:00 a.m. each day are typically the least crowded, but for everyone else, Tuesdays and Wednesdays during mid-morning hours or during the last hour the club is open (7:00 to 8:00 p.m.) are often reported to be the least crowded, according to customers. The most crowded times to visit the club are weekday afternoons, when many folks have recently gotten off of work, and weekend mornings and afternoons, when shoppers often stock up on groceries and household goods for the coming week.
